candidate.name: Mathew Hema
candidate.headline: Senior ICT Executive | Technology Strategy, Security and Transformation
candidate.work_rights: Australian citizen or permanent resident (confirm wording before use)
candidate.summary: Senior technology leader with 25 years across ICT management, cyber security and digital transformation, including CIO and Head of Technology appointments. Operates at board and executive level while staying hands-on with delivery. Sector experience across not-for-profit, financial services, education, healthcare and aged care, insurance, communications and manufacturing, in in-house, outsourced, cloud and hybrid environments.
candidate.pattern: Inherit a fragmented or under-invested ICT function, establish governance and a security baseline, rebuild the team and the vendor model, then reduce cost while lifting service levels and productivity.

titles: Head of Data, Digital and Technology

experience.title: Senior ICT Manager
bullets: Full accountability for ICT strategy, operations, security and budget for a national not-for-profit, reporting to the Executive Director, Finance and Business Improvement. Team of four.
Delivered a new e-commerce capability consolidating product sales, one-off and recurring donations and memberships into a single supporter transaction channel.
Leading an Essential Eight aligned security uplift with a SaaS and identity overlay, with a gap assessment and prioritised remediation roadmap for board reporting.
Integrating Salesforce, Microsoft 365, NetSuite and Asana to remove manual handoffs, and automating identity onboarding and offboarding through Microsoft Graph.
Rebuilding the membership model across WooCommerce and Salesforce to replace fragmented legacy processes.
Mapping all revenue streams end to end into NetSuite to close reconciliation gaps.

experience.title: Head of Data, Digital and Technology
bullets: Led a team of eight across software development, security, infrastructure, research and relationship management.
Set and executed the data, digital and technology strategy underpinning advocacy, professional learning, school improvement and compliance across the independent schools sector.
Delivered systems for tracking and reporting school funding, accountability and compliance, improving accuracy and removing manual effort.
Modernised communications and media platforms and delivered hybrid event and audiovisual capability.

experience.title: IT Service Delivery Manager (Contract)
bullets: Established a service delivery framework and lifted service management maturity.
Operationalised Essential Eight Maturity Level 3 controls into business as usual processes.
Scoped the infrastructure uplift to cloud as part of a wider transformation programme.

experience.title: Project Manager, Technical Operations (Contract)
bullets: Consolidated 32 years of accumulated technology across service delivery, infrastructure and security into an aligned enterprise operating model.

experience.title: IT Manager
bullets: Sole and then small-team accountability for ICT across a financial services business, engaging directly with C-level and the board.
Built and delivered a three-year technology plan aligned to the business strategy.
Implemented Essential Eight Maturity Level 3 security processes in a regulated financial services environment.
Matured the Salesforce platform from minimum viable product into the core business process system.
Managed the managed service provider and the multi-vendor SaaS ecosystem, consolidating and renegotiating where duplication existed.

experience.title: IT Infrastructure Manager
bullets: Led strategy, transformation and migration into Microsoft Azure for a manufacturing and supply chain business.
Managed the Microsoft Dynamics AX ERP platform and supporting infrastructure.
Transitioned to new IT vendors including the managed service provider and reduced communications cost across contracts, LAN, WAN, telephony and mobile fleet.

experience.title: Chief Information Officer
bullets: Owned ICT strategy, delivery and service through a cloud-based business transformation.
Built and launched an automated end-to-end online lending platform from inception to operations across PaaS, IaaS and SaaS in multiple cloud environments.
Redesigned and rebuilt the No Interest Loans Scheme platform in a separate cloud environment.
Rebuilt the ICT team to fit the new operating model, reduced ICT cost every quarter while maintaining SLAs, and owned all vendor sourcing and contract management.
Centralised data and reporting, delivering business analytics across multiple source systems.

experience.title: IT Operations Manager, Asia Pacific
bullets: Accountable for ICT across Asia Pacific for a global insurance services business, reporting to the Global CIO and working with teams in the USA, UK and India.
Supported growth from 165 to more than 1,000 employees and revenue from $20M to $80M per annum.
Managed a regional ICT budget of $5M or more per annum, delivering approximately 10% cost reduction and 10% productivity improvement year on year.
Implemented ISO 27001 security processes and led the Asia Pacific data loss prevention programme.
Introduced ITIL, PMBOK, PRINCE2 and Agile methodologies and led mobility and cloud adoption.

highlights: Scaled ICT for a global insurance services business through growth from 165 to more than 1,000 employees and revenue from $20M to $80M per annum, delivering approximately 10% cost reduction and 10% productivity improvement year on year.
Built and launched an automated end-to-end online lending platform from inception to live operations as CIO, then reused the learnings to rebuild the No Interest Loans Scheme platform.
Implemented Essential Eight Maturity Level 3 in two separate regulated organisations, and ISO 27001 security processes across Asia Pacific.
Rebuilt ICT teams and vendor models three times over, each time reducing cost while maintaining or improving SLA performance.

capabilities.Strategy and Governance: Multi-year ICT strategy and roadmaps, technology governance frameworks, board and executive reporting, IT policy development, ICT budget ownership and cost reduction.
capabilities.Security and Risk: ACSC Essential Eight (to Maturity Level 3), ISO 27001, PCI DSS, risk identification and mitigation, compliance and audit, data loss prevention, disaster recovery and business continuity.
capabilities.Delivery and Operations: SDLC ownership, Agile, PRINCE2, PMBOK and ITIL service management, project and programme delivery, SLA and continuous improvement.
capabilities.People and Vendors: Team building from one to thirty people, mentoring, performance management, MSP and SaaS vendor selection, contract negotiation.
capabilities.Platforms and Data: Cloud strategy and migration across greenfield, hybrid and on-premises, systems integration and APIs, data consolidation, business analytics and centralised reporting.

technical.Cloud and Identity: Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Conditional Access, Microsoft Defender, IaaS, PaaS and SaaS
technical.Business Systems: Salesforce (including NPSP), NetSuite ERP, Microsoft Dynamics AX, WordPress and WooCommerce, Asana, Jira
technical.Integration and Automation: REST APIs, Microsoft Graph, PowerShell, Azure Logic Apps, Zapier, ETL and reporting pipelines
technical.Security Tooling: Endpoint and email security, MDM including MobileIron, DLP, disk and removable media encryption, vulnerability and patch management

credentials: Board Member, Dandenong Community and Learning Centre (Nov 2024 - Present), board lead for IT, security and compliance
